# wolffcatskyy.dev

> Developer portfolio for wolffcatskyy — open-source security tools, homelab infrastructure, and macOS utilities.

## About

wolffcatskyy is an open-source developer focused on network security, CrowdSec integrations, UniFi networking, and homelab infrastructure. Projects range from threat feed importers and firewall bouncers to fan control utilities for Intel Macs.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wolffcatskyy.dev/): Project showcase — CrowdSec tools, UniFi bouncers, homelab utilities, and macOS apps.
- [smcFanControl CE](https://wolffcatskyy.dev/smcfancontrol): Community Edition of smcFanControl. Fan speed control for Intel Macs. Sleep/wake panic fix, boot-time daemon, SF Symbol icon, 500KB bundle (91% smaller than original).

## Projects

- **crowdsec-blocklist-import** — Import 120k+ IPs from {{FEED_COUNT}} free threat feeds into CrowdSec. pip install git+https://github.com/wolffcatskyy/crowdsec-blocklist-import
- **crowdsec-unifi-bouncer** — CrowdSec firewall bouncer for UniFi Dream Machines (UDM/UDR). Auto-recovers after firmware updates.
- **smcFanControl CE** — Community fork of smcFanControl. Lightweight fan control for Intel Macs.
- **gluetun-airvpn-edition** — Thin Docker VPN container fork optimized for AirVPN with WireGuard.
- **awesome-unifi** — Curated list of UniFi tools, libraries, and community resources.
- **crowdsec-unifi-suite** — One-command installer for the full CrowdSec + UniFi security stack.
- **emby-playback-guardian** — Protects Emby/Jellyfin during active streaming by pausing library tasks.
